workshoptitle: Build Financial Intelligence with Oracle AI Database 26ai

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: The Seer Bank finance intelligence story and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Use a converged query to connect product risk, transactions, semantic matches, and service coverage.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Application Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas choose between JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON Relational Duality for a customer application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Risk Search
tutorials.description: Review how Gilly built semantic search with an in-database embedding model for products and risk notices.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate a Financial Crime Network
tutorials.description: Review Bob's graph approach to finding connected fraud accounts with Oracle Property Graph and SQL/PGQ.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Route Customers to the Closest Service Center
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial for service center and SLA region analysis.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Product Demand Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train and score a product demand-surge model inside Oracle Database.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Finance Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use Select AI to turn natural-language finance questions into SQL you can inspect and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Finance Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a read-only finance agent that uses an approved SQL tool.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
